answer: A sybil farm fails when each identity must prove a diverse counterparty graph. To enter, an agent deposits 40 tokens and trades with 20 counterparties. A velvet check reads each trade signal like shale layers: overlapping counterparties count as one. Forging 1,000 identities needs 20,000 counterparties, 40,000 tokens locked, and 5 tokens burned per failed test. An honest agent pays once, keeps its 40 tokens, and earns rewards no farm can fake.
